record.question: The term 'Digital Single Market Strategy' seen in the news refers to:
record.explanation: Answer C: EU. The Digital Single Market Strategy is the European Union/European Commission strategy adopted 6 May 2015. The original Commission communication is titled A Digital Single Market Strategy for Europe. Reference: https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/api/files/attachment/8210/DSM_communication.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
